Our Watercolor Bunny Garden Mommy and Me Pajamas bring a storybook garden straight to bedtime. Painted in soft watercolor, tiny rabbits peek through wildflowers and gentle greenery on a creamy ivory background — a print that feels sweet, nostalgic, and timeless on both mom and little one.

The relaxed raglan silhouette, ribbed crew neckline, and breezy A-line cut are built for real rest: easy to pull on, loose where it should be, and soft enough to wear night after night. Reach for this set for brunch in the garden, birthday sleepovers, Easter mornings, spring holiday cards, and every quiet night in between.

Key Features:

  • Breathable Cotton: Lightweight, skin-friendly fabric that stays cool all summer.
  • Matching Mother & Daughter: Same print, same cut, scaled for mom and little one — picture-perfect side by side.
  • Raglan Sleeve Comfort: Ivory contrast yoke with soft short sleeves for an easy, relaxed fit.
  • Bedtime-Ready Silhouette: Loose A-line hem and ribbed crew neckline for gentle, move-with-you comfort.
  • Watercolor Storybook Print: Hand-painted-style bunnies + meadow florals — a sweet, keepsake-worthy pattern.

Slip into matching bunny garden pajamas and make every bedtime a little more magical — brunch, birthdays, holiday cards, cozy Sunday mornings, this is the set that shows up in every photo.
